name: GDM Login Banner Enabled
description: Ensures the GNOME Display Manager shows a login banner (banner-message-enable=true with banner-message-text). Passes with LEA_RULE_no_service when GDM is not installed.

validation.command: if [ -d /etc/gdm3 ] || [ -d /etc/gdm ]; then cat /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/* /etc/dconf/db/local.d/* /etc/gdm3/custom.conf /etc/gdm/custom.conf 2>/dev/null; echo 'LEA_GDM'; else echo 'LEA_RULE_no_service'; fi
